scope_note: The audited surface is every file below the Desktop composer root plus these load-bearing integration and end-to-end paths. A future source file in a scoped root fails until it is explicitly classified.

capabilities.visible_contract: Rich multiline editor, focus, IME composition, draft restoration, paste, and inline references.
capabilities.platform_dependency: Compose text input and Gateway session identity
capabilities.android_behavior: Composer now provides a multiline editor, IME-safe hardware shortcuts, private text-only drafts keyed by canonical durable session id with a 50-entry MRU/no-backup store, and canonical plain-text remote URL/path/session/Git references. Rich inline chips and native attachment acquisition remain missing.
capabilities.android_tests: SessionDraftStoreTest, ComposerContractTest, ChatViewModelTest, BackupRulesTest, ChatJourneyTest, and ComposerReferenceTextTest cover draft retention/fencing, process recreation, multiline input, keyboard guards, canonical reference text, and Android-local path exclusions.

capabilities.visible_contract: Idle send, running stop, mid-turn steer, queued-item edit/delete/send-next, and parked turn behavior.
capabilities.android_behavior: Slice 4 adds a profile-scoped, durable text-only FIFO queue keyed by canonical session id, explicit queue edit/save/cancel/delete/send-next/resume controls, parked queues before guarded interrupt, and deterministic idle/send, running/redirect, empty/stop, NeedsInput/queue, and idle-empty/send-next actions. Redirect uses session.redirect only: rejected, unsupported, and failed results retain one local queued copy; ambiguous results remain review-required with no automatic retry. Queue entries never contain Android URIs or attachments. Visual capture and native attachment evidence remain open for later slices.
capabilities.android_tests: ComposerQueueStoreTest, ComposerQueueControllerTest, ComposerQueueHistoryTest, ComposerContractTest, ChatViewModelTest, and ChatJourneyTest cover profile isolation, FIFO, parking, ambiguity, no duplicate drain, redirect fallback, history/undo, IME/modifier guards, and running-owner isolation. Full visual/device evidence remains open.

capabilities.visible_contract: Provider/model selector with reasoning effort, fast mode, loading/error state, and visible manual override.
capabilities.platform_dependency: Gateway model metadata and update events
capabilities.android_behavior: Android now loads Gateway model/provider metadata and effective controls through typed repository methods; fresh-draft choices are scoped manual preferences, live changes use optimistic/deferred/rejected rollback semantics, and create overrides are snapshotted at send. Compose exposes loading/error, provider/model, reasoning, fast, and deferred states with 48dp semantics. Visual capture evidence remains open.
capabilities.android_tests: ComposerControlsTest, GatewaySessionRepositoryTest, ChatViewModelTest, and ComposerControlsAccessibilityTest cover catalog/effective mapping, session-scoped config requests, deferred and rejected mutations, create snapshots, stale completion fencing, and 48dp/scope semantics.

deviation.reason: Android adapts Desktop's hover-oriented model pill into a 48dp bottom-sheet control while retaining the same backend-authoritative and manual-override distinctions; matched visual capture remains open.

capabilities.visible_contract: Pick, paste or drop supported kinds; show preview/progress/error/removal before reliable upload/reference submission.
capabilities.platform_dependency: Android scoped URI grants, decode/resize, and Gateway upload/reference routes
capabilities.android_behavior: Slice 6 adds SAF file acquisition with lifetime-scoped grants, memory-only bounded reads (magic-byte image classification, 8 MB per item, 16 MB aggregate, 8 per message), stage-then-submit through the Gateway image.attach_bytes / file.attach routes, prompt-safe @file:`name` references composed from server ref_text, and occurrence-keyed chips whose remove wipes payload bytes. Folder and clipboard-image acquisition remain deferred; Android never serializes content:// URIs, local paths, or grants to the Gateway.
capabilities.android_tests: ChatViewModelTest proves grant read/bounds/submit-as-bytes and refusal surfacing; GatewaySessionRepositoryTest proves attach-before-submit ordering, session_id on attach RPCs, and that a refused stage blocks prompt.submit; ComposerControlsAccessibilityTest proves chip name/state/remove semantics and the Files add-sheet row. Visual capture, preview thumbnails, retry-after-refusal-in-place, detach cleanup, and reconnect/reacquire behavior remain open.

deviation.reason: Desktop drag-drop/paste acquisition is adapted to an Android SAF picker; bytes are staged before submit and only Gateway-returned reference text enters prompts. Remaining deviations (folders, clipboard images, previews) stay unavailable rather than enabled no-ops until implemented.

capabilities.visible_contract: Dictation recording/transcription/error plus auto-speak, wake-word, and active voice-conversation controls.
capabilities.platform_dependency: Android microphone permission, recorder, speech APIs, and audio focus
capabilities.android_behavior: Slice 7 adds the audio authority seam (connection-owned authenticated HTTP transport with per-leg credential resolution cleared on close), typed transcribe/speak routes with Desktop contracts and empty-transcript-as-silence, bounded 16 kHz PCM capture with zero-on-close buffers and a raw cap enforced while pumping, sequence-fenced Media3 playback with finally-deleted temp files, the pure conversation state machine with operation fencing and whole-utterance stop matching, an exclusive mic-owner engine mutex, composer dictation and conversation controls (phase pill/mute/end replacing the action cluster while active) that never auto-submit, auto-speak backed by the Gateway's canonical voice.auto_tts config via read-modify-write of /api/config, and the wake-word lease protocol (wake.status/start/stop/pause/resume/feed with surface 'gui', client capture, explicit persist only on user gestures, local frame validation) served by a user-started microphone foreground service with a persistent notification. Still open: barge-in concurrent capture pipeline, permission recovery journeys, streaming TTS fallback path, and physical-device evidence.
capabilities.android_tests: VoicePolicyTest covers wire budgets, timeout scaling, and whole-utterance stop matching; VoiceEngineTest proves exclusive mic ownership, sequencer invalidation, and byte wiping for CapturedAudio/SpeechAudio; WakeWordRepositoryTest covers status parsing, persist semantics, refusal reasons, and local frame validation; VoicePreferenceRepositoryTest covers the /api/config read-modify-write. Emulator evidence: dictation start/stop cycle survives with an empty crash buffer after a transport-failure crash was found and fixed (transcription failures now surface as silence with the draft preserved). Conversation controller journeys, barge-in tests, streaming-TTS fallback tests, and physical-device acceptance remain open per plan section 5.

capabilities.visible_contract: Context menu/contributed actions and slash, @, path/session/URL, emoji, directive, suggestion, and no-result completion states.
capabilities.platform_dependency: Gateway completion/context providers and Android accessible menus
capabilities.android_behavior: Android provides a phone-safe Add bottom sheet for URL and prompt snippets, canonical plain-text URL/path/session/Git references, Gateway slash/path completions, local emoji search, explicit loading/error/no-result rows, and generation/session/cwd fencing. File/image/folder contributions remain excluded pending Slice 6 byte staging; rich chips and arbitrary Desktop JS contributions are not ported.
capabilities.android_tests: ComposerReferenceTextTest, ComposerControlsTest, GatewaySessionRepositoryTest, ChatViewModelTest, and ComposerControlsAccessibilityTest cover canonical wire text, URL/path boundaries, emoji ranking, mapped slash/path requests, stale generation fencing, accessible popup rows, and safe Add-sheet omissions.

deviation.reason: Android replaces Desktop hover/nested menus and rich chips with accessible bottom sheets and canonical plain text; native-only attachment contributions remain gated by Slice 6 byte staging.

capabilities.visible_contract: Composer-adjacent coding/branch/worktree, goal, preview, async, collapse, dismiss, and stop status stack.
capabilities.android_behavior: Slice 4 projects goal, todo, subagent, background/process, preview, generic progress, and durable queue rows into a bounded, separately scrolling stack ordered goal, todo, subagent, background plus preview, queue. Background actions are capability-gated. CodingContextProvider is Unavailable on Android, so branch/worktree controls are absent: the current Android Gateway has no authorized remote repository-status transport. Desktop remote coding can use its authenticated apps/desktop/src/lib/desktop-git.ts and /api/git facade; that authority does not exist in Android's Gateway contract. Visual capture and any future remote git capability remain open.
capabilities.android_tests: GatewaySessionRepositoryTest covers status projection, optional process/goal capability absence, and terminal clearing; ComposerStatusStack and ChatJourney coverage cover accessibility/order as the synthetic visual matrix is completed. Full visual/device evidence remains open.

capabilities.visible_contract: Parked turn response surfaces for clarify, dangerous command approval, sudo, secret, pending-input routing, refusal and reconnect.
capabilities.platform_dependency: Gateway request/response RPCs and safe in-memory secret handling
capabilities.android_behavior: Typed pending-input surfaces now exist: clarify (single/batch/open text), dangerous-command approval with only Gateway-offered choices, and sudo/secret entry in a FLAG_SECURE dialog whose state is wiped before the flag clears. Requests are generation/runtime/request/kind-fenced repository memory; cancel/back sends exactly one safe refusal; message completion, error, reclaim, or connection replacement clears matching pending state. NeedsInput survives tool progress and cannot be interrupted via Stop/Escape; queued typed text still routes through the slice-4 queue. Reconnect replay for clarify/approval via session.resume and approval.pending fallback remains open, as do visual captures.
capabilities.android_tests: PendingInputTest covers ingress parsing/fencing, NeedsInput precedence over tool events, wire shapes for all four responses, choice validation, sudo array wiping, transport-failure retention, and connection-reset clearing. ChatViewModelTest/ComposerContractTest cover queued text and Stop guards. Reconnect replay journeys and secure-dialog Robolectric journeys remain open work in this slice.

capabilities.visible_contract: Measured composer-width ladder at 561/560/321/320 and below, plus narrow/wide portrait and landscape arrangements.
capabilities.android_behavior: Composer measures its own container and implements the exact Full/Compact/Stacked thresholds at 561/560/321/320/319dp with IME padding and 48dp Android targets; full orientation and capture evidence remains incomplete.
capabilities.android_tests: ComposerContractTest proves the exact measured-width ladder; final visual capture still must cover required themes, orientations, font scale, IME, and motion variants.

deviation.reason: Android keeps the existing 48dp touch targets and explicit-send soft-keyboard interaction while reproducing the measured hierarchy in a later responsive slice.

capabilities.visible_contract: Accessible focus/order/live status, large font/reduced motion/IME variants, and safe reconnect/process recreation cleanup.
capabilities.platform_dependency: Android lifecycle, TalkBack semantics, permissions, and process-death policies
capabilities.android_behavior: Composer exposes 48dp semantic actions, explicit send/stop descriptions, multiline IME behavior, guarded physical shortcuts, no-backup per-session draft restoration, background flush, and canonical rehome fencing. TalkBack, large-font, reduced-motion, and physical IME evidence remains incomplete.
capabilities.android_tests: BackupRulesTest, ComposerContractTest, ChatViewModelTest, and ChatJourneyTest cover no-backup storage, process recreation, shortcut guards, action semantics, and running-owner navigation; final capture/device matrix remains open.

deviation.reason: Android replaces Desktop hover and Escape affordances with touch targets and system Back only where the same safe action remains available.
